note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1952. Nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue on Tuesday 20 May 1952; contests in Bessbrook North, Camlough and Moybane, polled Thursday 5 June 1952. No nominations for Crossmaglen, Drumintee and Moyra Castle, whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. No party labels printed. Polled Thursday 5 June 1952.
